notes: Game-feel values for the units in data/hardware/hardware.json (facts live there). Read by sim/hardware.gd. Validate with tools/check_tuning.py.

purchase_price_usd.note: Prices for units whose launch price is not in the data. The laptop is owned at the start; this price only applies to buying another. S17 Pro: about $2,340 implied by a reseller post (hardware.json price_note), provisional.

uptime.note: Share of the day a unit hashes. The laptop is the player's everyday computer, so it mines about half the day. Dedicated machines lose about 3% to restarts and maintenance.

gpu_cards_per_rig.note: Open-frame rigs of the era typically held 3 to 6 cards.

gpu_rig_overhead_usd.note: Frame, motherboard, CPU, RAM and PSU, bought with the first card of each rig.

gpu_rig_overhead_w.note: Host system and PSU losses on top of the cards' board power.

footprint_tiles.note: Floor space for the facility view (M3). Not used by the sim yet.

annual_failure_rate.unit: fraction per year, by age year
annual_failure_rate.note: Chance a unit fails in each year of its life (year 1, 2, 3, then 4 and later). Failures rise with age (GDD 7.9).

repair_cost_fraction.note: Broken units are repaired automatically when cash allows.

lead_time_days.note: Days from paying for new hardware to it arriving, by tier. Early ASICs were pre-ordered months ahead (GDD 7.2).

depreciation_years.note: GDD 7.2: straight-line over 3 years in the books.

new_price_tracks_hashprice.note: ASIC prices followed mining profitability. For these tiers the new price is the launch price scaled by 30-day hashprice now over hashprice at launch, within the clamp below. CPUs, GPUs and FPGAs keep their launch price.

new_price_clamp.note: Bounds on the hashprice scaling of ASIC new prices.

used_price_fraction.note: A used unit at age zero sells for this share of the current new price (GDD 7.2: used prices track hashprice).

used_useful_life_years.note: Used value falls linearly with age over this many years, down to the floor.

used_price_floor.note: Scrap value for a working but obsolete unit.

price_hashprice_window_days.note: Trailing window for the hashprice that scales ASIC new prices.
